BUYING & PROJECT PLANNING

Product Demonstrations & Sample Review Requests

Describe the model operation, decoration or cleaning demonstration you need, then discuss available actual media and samples.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →

Define What You Need to See

Demonstration needWhat to specify
Structure & partsModel, component fit and handling.
Lighting & powerActivation, light mode, power and cleaning for the selected model.
Artwork & samplesDecoration position, colours, physical sample and charges.

Media & Sample Scope

illustrations are not actual demonstration videos or test records. Ask whether relevant media is available. Sample specification, charges, preparation time and shipping are agreed for the project; free samples are not assumed.

Discuss Sample Arrangements →

Make the Next Step Specific

Share the model, use, estimated quantity, artwork, destination and required arrival date. Identify any items you have not decided.
